messages:
david_support: Hey team, customer ACME reports archive objects still showing up in search after we applied their custom 30d archival+delete policy last week. They say objects have tombstone flags but are searchable. Can anyone pull quick context?

sanjay_sre: ugh. do we know if KMS hold was applied for that account? if HSM/KMS key is disabled delete job might stall.

marco_infra: checking. I see a hold flag on account acme-123 in our control plane starting 1749900000. Noted an external legal hold tag: LEGAL-HOLD-ACME-2025.

katie_legal: @marco_infra yes legal placed a temporary export hold last Tues for litigation. We asked to pause irreversible deletes pending export. Did support mark that in case notes?

marco_infra: support note exists but the deletion pipeline still processed queued tombstones for non-held objects. The issue sounds like a mix: some objects were in the hold scope, others not — but customer claims even held objects are visible (should be tombstoned).

logs-bot: export job scheduled: export_id=exp_2025_045, started=1749921000, status=running. Auditlog tip: run `GET /audit/events?customer=acme-123&since=1749890000`

david_support: customer provided a repro: they query embeddings index and see 12 items returned with ids that match deleted objects. They sent object ids and timestamps. I'll paste snippet:
```
query: embeddings.search("acme-index", q="invoice 2024-11") -> returns ids: ["obj_9a3", "obj_f12", ...]
object metadata for obj_9a3: tombstone=true, deleted_at=1749905000
```

sanjay_sre: important: tombstone=true means soft-delete marker exists but search index may still have stale entries until index purge runs. We have two subsystems: deletion pipeline and index cleaner. Index cleaner runs hourly but can lag under backlog. Did ACME have a large backfill?

marco_infra: we saw a backlog spike last week during key rotation; index cleaner throughput dropped ~4x due to throttling on KMS decrypt for metadata. That could explain visible results.

katie_legal: customer is worried because legal hold was active and they expect objects to be non-recoverable in search until export completes. Is our behavior documented?

david_support: short answer: we pause irreversible deletes for held objects but we still mark tombstone and keep visibility suppressed once index cleaner completes. We need to confirm if index suppression failed for held objects specifically.

sanjay_sre: next steps: 1) run index query against ES directly to confirm presence 2) check deletion pipeline logs for obj ids 3) surface KMS HSM errors around decrypts 1749890000-1749910000. I'll run commands now.

marco_infra: ran quick ES query: 7 of the provided ids are still in index. index.documents.get shows last_indexed=1749906000. Deletion pipeline logs show tombstone events emitted for all ids at 1749905000, acked by queue. However index cleaner failed on 3 keys with KMS error code KMS_DECRYPT_RATE_LIMIT.

logs-bot: audit export note: export_id=exp_2025_045 includes these objects in export manifest; export job started 1749921000, currently streaming to secure bucket.\
katie_legal: ok that aligns: legal hold prevented hard-delete but not soft-delete markers. Customer concern is visibility — they think held objects should be invisible until export done. Is that a product expectation mismatch?\
david_support: we should clarify behavior to customer: soft-deleted items may remain in the index until index cleaner completes; legal hold only prevents permanent physical deletion. Offer mitigation: temporarily restrict search results via ACL enforcement for that account until export completes.\
sanjay_sre: mitigation steps we can do now: 1) re-run index cleaner for the affected shard(s) with high priority for acme-123 2) bump KMS decrypt concurrency for this export (short window) 3) apply a temporary search ACL flag to hide tombstoned docs. I can do 1+2 if infra OK.\
marco_infra: I can bump KMS concurrency for 20 minutes, request id infra-op-342. Will monitor HSM/KMS Throttle metrics. Also will trigger per-customer index cleaner run.\
david_support: I'll message the customer with transparent summary + ETA: we expect index entries to purge within ~15-30min after we bump concurrency and re-run cleaner. Offer to provide export manifest and screenshots as proof.\
katie_legal: please also confirm we won't inadvertently surface deleted content in exported package. Legal wants to ensure exported snapshot matches what they expect.\
sanjay_sre: export manifest includes tombstoned ids, but export pipeline reads object blobs from storage (object-level) and honors hold. We'll confirm exported blobs are raw copies. I'll verify checksums and report back.\
logs-bot: infra-op-342 approved by infra-ops, note: temporary KMS concurrency bump + index cleaner priority set for customer acme-123.\
david_support: Sent customer message: "Thanks — we found index cleanup lag combined with KMS throttle. We're prioritizing cleanup now and expect visible results in 30min. We'll follow up when done and share export manifest." (customer replied :thumbsup:)
